# EctoRollbackGuard v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

Detect destructive operations before rolling back Ecto migrations.

## Pages

- [EctoRollbackGuard](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [EctoRollbackGuard](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/EctoRollbackGuard.md): Detect destructive operations before rolling back Ecto migrations.
- [EctoRollbackGuard.Detector](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/EctoRollbackGuard.Detector.md): AST-based detection of destructive rollback operations in Ecto migrations.
- [EctoRollbackGuard.Enricher](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/EctoRollbackGuard.Enricher.md): Enriches detected operations with approximate row counts from PostgreSQL.
- [EctoRollbackGuard.Impact](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/EctoRollbackGuard.Impact.md): Represents the rollback impact of a single migration.
- [EctoRollbackGuard.Preview](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/EctoRollbackGuard.Preview.md): Orchestrates rollback impact preview: discovers migrations, detects
operations, and optionally enriches with row counts.

- [EctoRollbackGuard.Reporter](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/EctoRollbackGuard.Reporter.md): Formats rollback impact results for terminal and JSON output.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ecto_rollback_guard.preview](https://ecto-rollback-guard.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.EctoRollbackGuard.Preview.md): Preview which operations would execute and what data would be lost
when rolling back to a target migration version.
